header: Seals and standards, each linked to its certificate
text: One to ten marks. Every seal names itself in writing under the artwork, which is what makes the strip readable to somebody who has never seen the mark — and what turns each link into a distinguishable one.
note: Validity dates and certificate numbers belong here, where a lapsed seal is easy to spot and remove. A seal that has quietly expired is worse than no seal at all.
